reason: Platform labels only. Minerals, gas, time, supply, weapons and armor stay in the client snapshot.

roach.text: The backend may burrow an injured Roach and resurface it after it recovers.
roach.reason: MicroRoachSafe burrows below 40% health and unburrows above 70%.

baneling.text: The backend burrows Banelings while retreating and unburrows them to fight.
baneling.reason: MicroBanelingSafe issues burrow down on retreat and burrow up otherwise.

siege_tank.text: The backend sieges and unsieges the tank.
siege_tank.reason: MicroTanks is assigned to both siege tank forms.

viking.text: The backend switches Viking fighter and assault forms.
viking.reason: MicroVikingSafe returns a landed Viking to fighter mode on retreat.

liberator.text: The backend switches Liberator movement and defender mode.
liberator.reason: MicroLiberatorSafe leaves defender mode on retreat.

widow_mine.text: The backend burrows a Widow Mine near enemies and unburrows it to move.
widow_mine.reason: MicroWidowMine burrows within range 10 and unburrows beyond range 14 or on retreat.

hellion.text: The backend morphs between Hellion and Hellbat when an Armory makes the morph available.
hellion.reason: MicroHellionSafe morphs to Hellbat in a fight and back to Hellion on retreat.

thor.text: The backend switches Thor explosive and high-impact modes.
thor.reason: MicroThor morphs for heavy air or back to explosive mode.

observer.text: The backend switches Observer surveillance mode.
observer.reason: MicroObserverSafe enters and leaves surveillance mode.

warp_prism.text: The backend switches Warp Prism transport and phasing modes.
warp_prism.reason: MicroWarpPrismSafe phases and unphases the prism.

overseer.text: The backend can enter Overseer oversight mode near enemies.
overseer.reason: MicroOverseerSafe morphs to oversight mode when enemies are near.

broodling.platform_behavior: Spawned by a brood lord attack. It is not a train target.
broodling.reason: Temporary combat spawn visible in the observation.

locust.platform_behavior: Spawned by a swarm host. It is not a train target.
locust.reason: Temporary combat spawn visible in the observation.

interceptor.platform_behavior: Launched by a carrier. It is not a train target.

nydus_worm.platform_behavior: The worm is the exit of a nydus network. Placing it is not a separate action.
nydus_worm.reason: Observation alias, not a build target.

creep_tumor.platform_behavior: Created by spawn_creep_tumor. It is not a build target.
creep_tumor.reason: Queen tumor visible in the observation.

changeling.platform_behavior: Spawned by an overseer. It is not a train target.
changeling.reason: Temporary scout visible in the observation.
